prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 研发中心季度例会签到表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "姓名" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "部门" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 77px
  col 3: header "签到时间" · longest unbreakable word 42px · one-line width 62px
  col 4: header "签退时间" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 62px
  col 5: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 429px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"记录研发中心季度例会的参会人员、所属部门、签到与签退时间及相关情况。","reading":"读者按行核对人员和出勤情况，也会纵向比较签到、签退时间；备注较长的少数行可用多行文字说明情况。","groups":["姓名与部门共同识别参会人员及其归属。","签到时间与签退时间是一对对应字段，适合采用相同宽度，便于比较。","备注补充解释同一行的出勤情况，需要足够空间容纳自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["姓名和部门名称尽量保持完整，便于快速识别。","09:02、11:47 等时间值应保持完整，不在数字或冒号处分行。"],"may_wrap":["备注中的会议安排、请假和迟到说明可按语意自然换行；这些行增加的高度可同时容纳其他单元格的换行。","空间紧张时，部门名称或时间列表头可以换行，但会降低纵向扫描的连贯性。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [67, 98, 83, 83, 388] · table 720×338px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [67, 85, 78, 78, 411] · table 720×477px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [67, 120, 95, 95, 342] · table 720×338px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"姓名、部门和两个时间表头及时间值均保持完整；成对的时间列等宽，便于纵向比较。备注占据主要空间，只有两条长说明换行，行与行之间仍容易对应。","problems":"部门列比较紧凑；两条长备注在行尾被截开，续行较短，阅读节奏略显突兀。","cause":"部门列为98px，文字空间恰好容纳最宽部门名称；备注列为388px，仍不足以容纳最长说明的单行宽度。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"备注列最宽，迟到说明保持单行；签到与签退列等宽，时间值本身完整。","problems":"部门名称逐行断开，两个时间表头也换成两行，所有行都变高，削弱了人员、部门和时间之间的快速对应。额外的备注空间只让一条长说明减少换行，代价偏大。","cause":"部门列缩至85px，文字空间不足以容纳最长部门名称；两个时间列各78px，文字空间不足以容纳完整表头。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"姓名、部门和时间字段完整，两个时间列等宽；较宽的部门列让人员归属更从容，行高与r0A相同。","problems":"部门和时间列的留白较多，挤占备注空间；两条长备注的续行更长，说明文字的阅读节奏不如r0A紧凑。","cause":"部门列120px、时间列各95px，均超过保持内容单行所需的宽度，使备注列缩至342px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"平衡部门与备注","widths":[67,106,83,83,380],"change":"以r0A为基础，给部门列增加8px余量，保留等宽且足以容纳表头的时间列；从备注列转出同等宽度，尝试在部门的舒展程度与长备注的换行之间取得平衡。"}]}
